title: Pokemon Japanese Arbok AR 079/071 sv5K Wild Force Art Rare Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Pokemon Japanese - Arbok Art Rare 079/071 - sv5K Wild Force

Japanese-language Art Rare (AR) from Scarlet & Violet series set sv5K "Wild Force". Card number 079/071, illustrated by OKUBO, (c) 2024 Pokemon.

- Pokemon: Arbok (Darkness/Psychic, 130 HP, Stage 1, evolves from Ekans)
- Rarity: Art Rare (AR) - full-art alternate illustration
- Card number: 079/071
- Set: sv5K Wild Force (Japanese)
- Illustrator: OKUBO
- Ungraded, raw single

Condition: Pulled and sleeved straight away, handled by the edges. Front and back are both photographed - please judge corners, edges, surface and centering for yourself from the images, as they are of the actual card you will receive. Shown in a semi-rigid holder in the photos.

Shipping: Penny sleeve into a top loader, inside a bubble mailer with cardboard backing. Combined shipping on multiple purchases - just ask before paying.
